programme.title: The Haunting of...: Margaret Cho
programme.desc: Comedienne and actress, Margaret Cho (Drop Dead Diva) returns to the house in Peachtree, Georgia where she experienced such a terrifying and violent energy that the memory continues to haunt her today.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Haunted Parade
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hoylake and investigate a building known as The Parade. Dating back to 1909, this once former school, still seems to have ghostly pupils and teachers taking class.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Big Mommas House 2
programme.desc: FBI agenten Malcolm Turner (Lawrence) har nu skrivebordsjob, kone ogventer barn. Men da nationens sikkerhed står på spil, må Turner somBig Momma agere barnepige for tre møgunger.

programme.title: My Better Halves
programme.desc: Kriminalforfatteren Charles har skriveblokering. I jagten på inspiration beder han spiritisten Madame Arcati lave en seance. Det fører til mere end forventet, da Madame Arcati fremmaner genfærdet af Charles' kone, Elvira, der vil genoptage sit liv.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: En usædvanlig spion udfører en hemmelig mission under 2. verdenskrig, hvor virkelighed og bedrag konfronteres i en intens kamp mod fjenden.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist
programme.desc: Bank robbery is a brazen yet simple crime. A mask, a gun, a note passed to a teller. But bank burglary is different. It takes skill to disable an alarm, to penetrate a locked vault.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: Ernest Rides Again
programme.desc: I denne skøre komedie finder den klovneagtige Ernest P. Worrell og hans tumpede ven Abner en kæmpe kanon, der siges at indeholde Englands kronjuveler. Bemærk denne film vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Summer Rental
programme.desc: Carl Reiner (The Jerk) instruerede denne historie om John Candy som en familiefar, der tager en pause fra sund fornuft, når han lejer et sommerhus i Florida.

programme.title: Mit hjem i Hampstead
programme.desc: 'Mit hjem i Hampstead' er en sjov og livsbekræftende feelgood-film om, at kærligheden findes de mest uventede steder og beviser én gang for alle, at alder ikke er en hindring for at starte helt forfra.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: Himlen over Wenders krigshærgede Berlin er fyldt med engle i trench-coats, der usynligt bevæger sig rundt blandt menneskene og lytter til deres fortvivlede tanker og prøver at støtte dem.

programme.title: I'm Not There
programme.desc: I'm Not There' er en svimlende tur gennem Bob Dylans mytologiske verden og omskiftelige liv. Seks forskellige skuespillere spiller seks forskellige sider af Dylan i hans mest frugtbare årtier alt sammen set og hørt igennem Dylans udødelige tekster.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe er ellers sådan en fredelig fyr, men nu har han ikke noget andet valg end, på ægte 'Bud Spencer' manér, at smide mafiaen ud af landsbyen Amanlido, så der igen kan blive fredeligt at bo der!

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-ekspert Friar finder en bombe spændt fast til sin skrivebordsstol, og en uset hacker beordrer ham til at stjæle digitale pengebeløb online – ellers vil hans datter blive bortført.

programme.title: Final Target
programme.desc: Ava er en dødsensfarlig lejesoldat, der har højprofilerede lejemord som speciale. Men en opgave går galt, og hendes arbejdsgivere sender i al hemmelighed en lejemorder efter hende...

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson er tilbage som den tidligere CIA-agent Bryan Mills, der er ved at blive forsonet med sin ekskone, da hun bliver brutalt myrdet. Mills bliver beskyldt for mordet og tager flugten optændt af raseri og med CIA, FBI og politiet i hælene.

programme.title: The Con is On
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at slippe for at betale en gigantisk spillegæld, flygter Harriet og Peter til Hollywood. Planen er, at infiltrere et juvelrøveri som involverer Peters eks-kone.

programme.title: Mutant X: magtspil
programme.desc: Holdet kæmper for at gøre en militær oberst, der har truet med at udløse et nukleart holocaust, ukampdygtig.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kærlighedsbrev
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Frankrig for at lede efter Josephine Pontoise og Guy de Bourdins forsvundne bryllupsløfter, som kan bevise, at deres arving er den retmæssige ejer af St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Et godt år
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel rejser til Frankrig for at finde de forsvundne sten fra Marie Antoinettes krone.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Intet andet end sandheden
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel genforenes med Stewie Harper i jagten på sandhedens bæger i Frankrig.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Den sidste ridder
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel tager til Paris i Frankrig for at finde Jacques de Molays sværd, stormesteren af tempelridderne. Den rivaliserende relikviejæger Rita Rosellini er også ude efter sværdet.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene
programme.desc: When a young woman was grabbed from her Texas home, the police raced to find her abductors. On the face of it, the kidnapping seemed like the random act of desperate men.
